authoringNote: DESIGN INPUT ONLY. Merge missions into both data/missions.json and MISSIONS.json; implement all runtime rules and validations.

missions.title: Meet the Neighbours
missions.short: Read names and deliver 3 welcome cards.
missions.goal: Talk to Ada, Ollie and Fern; match each greeting card to its name.
hints: Look for name labels above villagers.
Say the name before handing over a card.
Find Ada at the market, Ollie near town hall and Fern at the green.
missions.worldEffect: Three villagers wave and become available for follow-up jobs

missions.title: Bakery Busy Day
missions.short: Help Ada make 3 orders using the right amounts.
missions.goal: Read 3 customer orders and count the correct bread and cake items.
hints: Start with the picture cards.
Count the buns for each customer.
Check the total before serving.

missions.title: Lost Library Books
missions.short: Find 4 books and put them on the right shelves.
missions.goal: Collect labelled books and match each to its shelf.
hints: Search near the village paths.
Read the big word on each cover.
Match the cover word to the shelf word.
learning: read SUN, MOON, TREE and STAR

missions.title: Road Sign Rescue
missions.short: Put 3 direction signs in the correct places.
missions.goal: Fix signs pointing to MARKET, WORKSHOP and GREEN.
hints: Match each sign to its coloured socket.
Look at the arrow and the landmark.
Try the direction again if it is wrong.
missions.worldEffect: Missing road direction signs become visible

missions.title: Garden Patterns
missions.short: Plant a red-blue pattern across 6 flowerbeds.
missions.goal: Complete the repeating flower pattern RED, BLUE, RED, BLUE, RED, BLUE.
hints: Look at the first two flowers.
Repeat the same two colours.
Six beds make three pairs.
missions.worldEffect: Community garden blooms with six flowerbeds

missions.title: The Delivery Round
missions.short: Drive 3 parcels to the right villagers.
missions.goal: Load parcels for Ada, Pip and Ivy and deliver to matching names.
hints: Read the name on each parcel.
Check the mini-map or road signs.
Stop near each recipient and press E.
missions.worldEffect: Village notice board displays completed delivery route

missions.title: Market Day Maths
missions.short: Fill 3 shopping lists without exceeding 20 job coins.
missions.goal: Buy 2 bread, 1 milk and 2 apples from a separate job purse.
hints: Bread costs 3. Milk costs 4. Apples cost 2 each.
Add each price as you shop.
You have 20 job coins. Spend 14 and keep 6.

missions.title: Mechanic’s Toolbox
missions.short: Fix Pip’s vehicle with 2 tyres, 1 lamp and 1 battery.
missions.goal: Find four repair parts, then fit them in the correct sequence.
hints: Inspect the broken car first.
Two tyres go on before the lamp.
Fit the battery last.
missions.worldEffect: Pip’s car becomes driveable after repair

missions.title: The Grand Rally
missions.short: Drive 6 gates on the new long circuit beside Pip.
missions.goal: Drive six numbered gates; finish to win, with an optional time medal.
hints: Follow big signs 1 to 6.
Wide corners are safer than sharp turns.
There is no required time limit.
missions.worldEffect: New rally podium and trophy appear

missions.title: Village Festival
missions.short: Prepare the village festival with decorations and invitations.
missions.goal: Deliver 3 invitations, place 2 tables and hang 3 lanterns.
hints: First invite the neighbours.
Then put the tables in the marked spots.
Finally hang all three lanterns.
missions.worldEffect: Second chapter festival, lanterns and music unlock
